description: Generate a high-quality video from text using Kling AI (Kuaishou). Supports standard and professional modes. Returns a task_id to poll for completion.

image_url.description: Optional reference image URL for image-to-video

mode.description: Generation mode: std (standard) or pro (professional, slower). Default: std

model.description: Model name: kling-v1 or kling-v1-5 (default: kling-v1)

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid in the video

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate

name: kling_generate_video
